meaning: Implementation and evidence permit final report generation. Final report QA and distribution verification must still finish before overall user delivery is complete.

automatic_decomposition.validation_scope: Dedicated offline four-stage window, two caller goals, normal and one controlled transient review rejection.

requirement_scopes.error_detection_retry: Bounded fresh-observation replanning, raw failure retention, unknown-dispatch stop; controlled transient desktop recovery plus CPU counterexamples.
requirement_scopes.perception_accuracy_speed: Frozen held-out OCR accuracy and paired component timings; screen OCR is slower and no general end-to-end speedup is claimed.
requirement_scopes.live_monitoring_logs: Passive stage/status/budget/PID identity records and original per-step logs; no model-internal real-time progress claim.

remaining: Hierarchical semantic subgoal sequences and dependency graphs are not implemented by rolling mode.
Dedicated-window acceptance does not establish arbitrary application or cross-resolution success rates.
Sky bridge activation and input-service waits are included in elapsed time; unattended execution latency is not established.
The screen OCR accuracy gain has a processing-time cost; full perception is not generally faster.
